full_track.tags: K-Pop Ballad. Features a clean electric guitar playing arpeggiated chords with light chorus and delay. A warm synth pad provides harmonic sustain. The arrangement builds with a subtle shaker and a soft, mid-range kick drum. A male vocalist sings in a sentimental, breathy style, transitioning into a more powerful chest voice in the higher register. The bass guitar plays melodic, legato lines that follow the vocal phrasing. 72 BPM, Key of E Major, 4/4 time signature.
